sloka: नैवम् भव Gऋहाणेदम् यदाह वसुधाधिपः ।भर्तुरिच्चामुपास्वेह जनस्यास्य गतिर्भव ॥२-३५-२९॥
transliteration: naivam bhava Gṛhāṇedam yadāha vasudhādhipaḥ ।bharturiccāmupāsveha janasyāsya gatirbhava ॥2-35-29॥

translations.english: Do not be like your mother. Accept what the king says. Abide by his wishes. Be his saviour.
